verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents an Experimentation product with Bayesian results that highlight a leading or winning variation. However, the evidence never says that experiment configurations or results can be read programmatically. The MCP server is documented only for flags, AgentControl configs and observability data, and the CLI only for flags, members, projects, environments and teams. Read-scoped API tokens are a generic building block, not documented experiment-results access, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can read experiment configurations and results programmatically to summarize outcomes and recommend ship/rollback decisions
